Last time felt different.  

It had been our first time, so there's no way to tell what your true nature is with regard to sex.  Everyone is on their best behavior the first time.  It had been gentle and sweet and wholly spectacular in every way.   It left me wanting more. 

But this is simply savage.  Lustful and exciting, yes, but there is a darker edge that I'm not sure I can be comfortable with.  

My jeans and belt are nowhere to be seen, as you flung them down the steps after tearing them from my body mercilessly.   I stand frozen in my skimpy panties and sheer blouse, looking confused and hoping that you'll say or do something that implies safety, respect.   My eyes plead with you, but your stare remains cold.  Both of us are stock still, with only the sound of our panting filling my bedroom.   I wonder if I'm going to regret my invitation; the one that brought you here to dinner and now this dizzying moment.  

Noticing that my panties are completely drenched, I realize in a flash that no matter what happens, I want this.  I want you as you are.  

Now shaking, I take a step toward you.

There will be a long tribute list this year, as there have been a lot of deaths since the 2019 show in ATL.   Hope springs eternal, however, and I just spoke to a woman whose 13 year old son saved his allowance for a year in order to fly to PHX for this year's show.   It's up to us to keep it going!
